qa_pairs.question: Which transmission types use 22 Nm torque for the shift segment to shaft?
What is the highest torque value specified in the Interior Shift Elements section?
qa_pairs.answer: 35 Nm for the A5S 300J transmission shift segment to shaft

qa_pairs.question: Which component uses a 5/16 inch screw in the Interior Shift Elements section?
qa_pairs.answer: The detent spring on shift unit for A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmissions
